🃏 TripleTriad

A card battle game from the Final Fantasy series: place cards on a 3x3 grid. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Place your cards on the 3x3 grid, one per turn.
  2. Adjacent cards battle on shared edges — the higher number wins.
  3. Winning a battle flips the opponent's card to your side.
  4. Control the most cards when all nine spaces are filled to win.
  5. Strategic placement and card value order matter — some rules trigger card swaps.
